channel.title: HelpDesk incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from HelpDesk's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Performance degradation of our services [resolved]
item.description:
We see that the issue within our cloud provider’s infrastructure has been mitigated, and we can confirm that the infrastructure is healthy, and we are not seeing further errors.
Throughout the degradation, our platform was able to maintain service continuity.
We appreciate your patience and understanding while we coordinated our efforts with the cloud provider’s engineers to address the issue.

item.title: Performance degradation of our services [resolved]
item.description:
The issue within our cloud provider’s infrastructure has been mitigated, and we can confirm that all affected resources have been fully restored.
Our platform has remained available throughout, thanks to built-in redundancy and failover across multiple locations. While parts of the underlying infrastructure were experiencing problems, we continued to serve traffic and deliver the service without a full outage.
Thank you for your patience and understanding while we coordinated our efforts with cloud provider’s engineers to address the issue.

item.title: Issues with messages delivery [resolved]
item.description: We noticed some issues with messages delivery; after investigation, we've seen an abnormal messaging queue. We were able to resolve the issue completely

item.title: Unavailability of the HelpDesk Agent Application [resolved]
Impaired access to HelpDesk application [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been mitigated. HelpDesk services are back fully operational

item.title: We experienced a temporary problem with sending tickets that was resolved [resolved]
item.description: All of your tickets were delivered, but some might have experienced a delay. The issue has been identified and the fix was implemented. All systems are working. The issue lasted for about 40 minutes from 17:30 UTC.

item.title: Issue with rating links [resolved]
item.description: For approximately 24 hours, we experienced a link failure that prevented us from collecting ticket ratings. Currently, this issue has been resolved, and links are working correctly.

item.title: Issues with priority changes [resolved]
item.description: We noticed an issue when using the ticket search feature, causing the priority of some tickets to change to “Urgent.” We were able to resolve the issue completely, but the affected tickets retained the “Urgent” priority. You may be required to change the previous priority manually.

item.title: Issues with actions within the application [resolved]
HelpDesk agent application - delay in loading times [resolved]
HelpDesk application issue [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved. The agent application is now working properly.
